story.title: Diagnose fan-out and replay incremental arrivals
story.objective: Separate join cardinality from incremental event identity.
story.audience: Instructor demonstration; completed instructor copy is explicitly identified
story.prerequisites: Prepared runtime and assigned disposable resources; authenticate outside recording

caption.notice: The five holdings reconcile to total exposure 250.

action.command: python3 -c "import csv; h=list(csv.DictReader(open('seeds/holdings.csv'))); f=list(csv.DictReader(open('fixtures/fund_labels_duplicate.csv'))); j=[r for r in h for x in f if r['fund_id']==x['fund_id']]; print(len(j),sum(float(r['market_value']) for r in j))"

caption.action: Calculate the duplicate-lookup effect from actual CSVs.
caption.notice: The duplicate A lookup creates seven joined rows and total 400; it needs a declared cardinality rule.

action.command:
cp models/fund_exposure.sql fund_exposure.saved.sql
cp fixtures/fund_labels_duplicate.csv seeds/fund_labels.csv
cat > models/fund_exposure.sql <<'SQL'
select h.fund_id,count(*) as holdings,sum(h.market_value) as exposure
from {{ ref('stg_holdings') }} h join {{ ref('fund_labels') }} f using(fund_id)
group by h.fund_id
SQL
dbt seed --select fund_labels --profiles-dir . && dbt run --select fund_exposure --profiles-dir . && dbt test --select reconcile_exposure --profiles-dir .

caption.action: Run the defective join and its reconciliation test.
caption.notice: The actual output has seven holdings and exposure 400; reconciliation rejects it.
The consumer model uses the unique fund dimension and again reconciles to 250.

action.command: dbt run --select arrival_ledger --profiles-dir . && python3 inspect-output.py arrival-ledger

printf 'event_id,fund_id,market_value
e1,A,125
e2,B,80
e3,C,20
' > seeds/arrivals.csv
dbt seed --select arrivals --profiles-dir . && dbt run --select arrival_ledger --profiles-dir . && python3 inspect-output.py arrival-ledger

action.command: dbt run --select arrival_ledger --profiles-dir . && python3 inspect-output.py arrival-ledger

caption.notice: The event count remains three and the total remains 225.
